_comment: Registry of the primary sources this kit fetches from. Every URL here is an
official or primary publisher. Nothing in data/ may be written without a
matching entry, and every dataset carries a MANIFEST.json recording which
entry it came from and when.
max_age_days is the staleness budget: how long a fetched value may be quoted

hs_nomenclature.title: WCO Harmonized System nomenclature (HS 2022)
hs_nomenclature.publisher: World Customs Organization, via the Open Knowledge 'harmonized-system' data package (UN Comtrade extraction)
hs_nomenclature.gives: HS 2/4/6-digit codes, descriptions, section and chapter tree
hs_nomenclature.does_not_give: India's 8-digit ITC(HS) extensions, and no duty rates of any kind

icegate_duty_calculator.title: ICEGATE Custom Duty Calculator
icegate_duty_calculator.gives: BCD, IGST, SWS, AIDC, cess and applicable notifications for an 8-digit ITC(HS)
icegate_duty_calculator.notes: Client-rendered; needs Playwright. This is the authoritative rate source for a Bill of Entry.

cbic_exchange_rate.title: CBIC notified customs exchange rates (ERAM)
cbic_exchange_rate.gives: Notified INR conversion rates for imported and exported goods, by currency
cbic_exchange_rate.notes: Revised on the 1st and/or 3rd Thursday each month under ERAM, effective the following Friday. Use the rate in force on the Bill of Entry date, never the spot rate.

dgft_itchs.title: DGFT ITC(HS) import policy schedule
dgft_itchs.gives: Import policy per 8-digit line: Free / Restricted / Prohibited / STE, and policy conditions

cbic_gst_rates.title: CBIC GST goods and services rates
cbic_gst_rates.gives: GST/IGST rate schedule by chapter and HSN, and compensation cess schedule

drewry_wci.title: Drewry World Container Index (weekly)
drewry_wci.gives: Composite index plus 8 route indices, USD per 40ft container
drewry_wci.notes: Benchmark only. No Drewry route covers Far East to India directly, so use it to read market direction, not to price your lane.

freightos_fbx.title: Freightos Baltic Index (FBX)
freightos_fbx.notes: IOSCO-compliant. Terminal access may require a subscription.
